text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, it's nice and cool in here! Geez, I
never
thought I'd be barging into your
room, but here
we are.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes the unexpected happens.
Who could
have predicted the AC would
break down
suddenly? Take your time
and relax.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, take your time! Fate is one
mischievous
trickster, but it has
delivered you to my stage. I'd
say that's
most fortuitous!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, does a day go by where she's not
this
annoying? ...Hm? Where's Doto,
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-don't worry about me! Sorry, I'll just
be... here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Doto, why are you under the
bed?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I-I'm trying to take up as little space
as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why do you always gotta be so
sad? Look
at the floor space—you'll
hardly be taking up
anything, so get
outta there!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeep, b-but... I don't want to be a
bother!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaa ha ha ha! What merriment! Why, it
reminds
me of the tale of Amaterasu
when she secluded
herself in the
heavenly rock cave!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I will lure you out with a merry
tune! La
la laaa, the rooster dances with
the
Overlooord! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut uuup!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Taking personality into account,
her
attention won't be piqued by
curiosity or logical
reasoning. We should
appeal to her fundamental
desires
instead.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Doto, I have a delicious, frozen banana
for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, as if she'll be tempted by
food!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Damn it... Ugh, fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto, I want you to get everyone some
cold
treats from the school store. I'll
reimburse you
later.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! I'll go right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, block off the bottom of the
bed while
she's gone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'll get the rose ice cream for
Opera O,
banana juice for Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does "everyone" include me? Oh... That's what Shakur was doing...
